query: 安全管理体系（ISO 45001） 安全管理体系（ISO 45001） 衡量职业健康安全体系认证覆盖和有效性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：通过了 ISO 45001（或同等 OHSAS 18001）体系认证，且披露了内外部审核频率、安全风险识别机制及具体的职业病预防成效。 • 1分（合格）：建立了内部安全管理制度，具备基础的安全生产操作规程，但尚未获得第三方认证，或认证已过期但仍有管理动作。 • 0分（不合格）：无体系认证且无明确的安全管理制度披露。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：体系认证覆盖 >80% 的生产场地、实体数量、营业收入或员工人数（即你原始定义的 3分/4分 区间）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对生产部门认证而忽略了物流/行政部门，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关认证覆盖信息。 职业健康安全管理体系 职业病预防 认证覆盖率 安全生产管理体系 ISO 45001 OHSAS 18001 ISO 45001 OHSAS 18001 occupational health and safety management system OHS certification occupational disease prevention certification coverage 企业是否通过ISO 45001或同等OHSAS 18001认证？ 认证机构、证书有效期与认证范围是什么？ 认证覆盖多少生产场地、实体、营收或员工？ 是否披露内外部审核频率？ 是否披露安全风险识别机制及职业病预防成效？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '安全管理体系（ISO 45001）'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否通过ISO 45001或同等OHSAS 18001认证？ 认证机构、证书有效期与认证范围是什么？ 认证覆盖多少生产场地、实体、营收或员工？ 是否披露内外部审核频率？ 是否披露安全风险识别机制及职业病预防成效？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有一般安全生产口号；仅有承包商安全协议而无体系认证/管理制度；仅有事故率数字而无体系说明；仅有消防演练案例；区分：本指标关注企业OHS体系认证与有效性；承包商安全管理关注外包方准入培训监督；ESG数据第三方鉴证不是ISO 45001安全体系认证。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Fire safety and warehouse safety are important issues for cargo handling and storage. To minimise the risk of fire, the Group implemented several measures in preventing fire. In the fire safety plan, there are regular fire inspections and maintenance of fire service installations and equipment. Fire safety and warehouse safety are important issues for cargo handling and storage. To minimise the risk of fire, the Group implemented several measures in preventing fire. In the fire safety plan, there are regular fire inspections and maintenance of fire service installations and equipment. Cargo ports conduct fire drills in order to practice and prepare for handling a fire emergency. In addition, we maintain good warehouse housekeeping all the time to ensure and improve safety.

results.section: Safety and Health / Passenger and Crew Safety
results.text: The Group has a strong responsibility towards our passengers and employees to ensure safety on ferries and ships. We have formulated and implemented the Safety Management Manual for Ships and other standards and guidelines to guide employees on daily maintenance and inspection to ensure the proper functioning and safe operation of ferries and ships. We also provide instructions on how to manage and respond to scenarios such as severe weather conditions and fires to subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, so as to eliminate potential risks and ensure safe operation of ferries, ships and cruise ship. In order to enhance the contingency preparedness and situational awareness of the subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, we conduct emergency exercises simulation exercises are regularly conducted such as spill collision, stranding of ferry and hull damage simulation. Safety training is carried out periodically to foster a safety awareness culture and to ensure that the Group's safety standards are communicated effectively. During the Reporting Period, there was no case of significant safety accident in passenger transportation.

We also provide instructions on how to manage and respond to scenarios such as severe weather conditions and fires to subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, so as to eliminate potential risks and ensure safe operation of ferries, ships and cruise ship. results.section: Safety and Health / Passenger and Crew Safety
results.text: Machinery safety is essential as machine operation without proper safety management poses serious threats to the employees at the cargo terminals. To prevent the occurrence of workplace accidents, the Group focuses on the improvement of the working environment and equipment safety. We safeguard machine operators' safety by providing them with safe and reliable machinery and clear operating guidelines. Furthermore, regular machinery maintenance is conducted to conserve their conditions as well as extend their lifespan. This is conducive to avoiding workplace injuries and fatalities caused by malfunctioning machinery, maintaining a safe working environment for employees.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Safety and Health
results.text: The Group provides adequate and personal protective equipment to employees based on their nature of work. Understanding fatigue can affect employees' health, safety and work performance, the Group prevents fatigue accidents in the workplace by establishing reasonable work arrangements to avoid excessively long shifts. In addition, the Group provides employees with common rooms, and adequate breaks for them to take rest. To protect our drivers' health, the Group installs air cushions in the driver's cab of terminal tractors for shock absorption, providing greater comfort and stability while reducing drivers' spinal stress when driving.
